coding_rules: Add code only in htt/htt/htt/infer/r54_*.py, scripts/r54 and tests/r54. Reuse the listed API; do not re-implement it.
Every script writes one JSON under RESULTS/ with schema, node, claim_tier, provenance and limitations, then calls no plotting unless asked.
Every new function gets a test that names the equation or gate it protects.
Fail closed: raise on shape, unit, frame or identity mismatch. Never catch an exception to continue.
After each node: run the tests, run the node's mutation gates, run `python scripts/r54/build_r54_contract.py build`, commit with the card id as prefix, push without force.

The mutation receipt rewrites one source file at a time in place and restores it. Never run it while another process of yours is running or queued; a run that was killed is repaired by running it again.

rules.rule: At a fixed carrier and covariance the comparison of any view, compression or re-coordinatization with the exact likelihood is a tie by theorem. Report it as a theorem. A measured power ratio different from one is a defect to locate, never a result. A different nuisance model or covariance is a different analysis and is labelled as such.

Views, bodies and directions read from one cylinder of R54-EQ-20 are valid simultaneously when c^2 is the chi-square quantile with rank(F) degrees of freedom. State rank(F); do not split the level between views.
Along a direction outside row(F) the interval is reported as unbounded. A finite number there is quoted only together with the named body or prior that produces it.

Where a covariance estimated from n simulations enters a GLS fit with p - k > 0, the second moments carry the factors of wishart_gls_factors(n, p, k). Leave-one-out calibration (R54-L01) remains the test of the intervals; this rule adds no obligation to an executed node.

Identification is stated per irreducible block (l, parity) as the rank of a multiplicity matrix. Vorticity has no column in any scalar observable at first order; say so together with the scope clause C6.6 (tensors at the observer or homogeneous histories, isotropic and parity-symmetric sources and measurement, first order). B_2 and the toroidal proper-motion quadrupole are null channels: a signal there is a gate failure, not a parameter estimate.

Relative distances identify only the sums of a depth-independent Hubble multipole and the zero-point pattern of each sample. Equality of zero points between samples is testable; a vanishing constant multipole is not. A bound on a constant Hubble multipole is quoted only with its calibration body.

A limit on a shear amplitude is quoted only with its history family (at most two parameters per tensor component with T and E, one with T alone) or with its sign restriction. A ratio Sigma_E/Sigma_T outside [rho_min, rho_max] is reported as a sign change of the history.

The closure of R54-EQ-38 between a count population and a distance window of the same shell is an identity and tests only the measurement chain. A global tilt is tested across different shells; its residual degrees of freedom are 3 (n_c + n_d - 1) at full rank.
